description: Capture and print photos on BLE and USB thermal printers.

store.summary: Capture a photo, dither it, and print over BLE or USB.
store.description: Zero Print turns a CardputerZero photo into a monochrome thermal print. Choose an MX06 BLE printer or a USB ESC/POS printer, then select Floyd-Steinberg, Atkinson, or threshold dithering before printing.
